newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Doctors start meeting on planned Yeltsin heart op.
newsitem.headline: Doctors start meeting on planned Yeltsin heart op.

text.p: Top doctors started a meeting in the Central Clinical Hospital in Moscow on Wednesday to decide whether to go ahead with planned surgery on President Boris Yeltsin's heart, and when and how it should be performed.

Itar-Tass news agency, which quoted hospital officials in its report of the start of the meeting, did not say whether Yeltsin was present. Yeltsin's press secretary said on Tuesday that the 65-year-old Russian leader would attend.
